surface_mechanism_description: The reaction mechanism involves the surface reaction of COOH groups with Fe(hfa)2TMEDA, leading to the formation of (COO)2 FeTMEDA and release of Hhfa. Subsequently, oxalic acid bonds as a bidentate ligand to Fe, releasing TMEDA and Hhfa.
evidence: The reaction mechanisms were proposed by calculating the /Delta1m values from possible reaction routes and comparing them with the experimental data. The equations and intermediate species were derived from the discussion of the reaction mechanisms in the text.
